quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 164, 125, or 119?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 164, 125, and 119, the number 164 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: Counting one by one from 1, you would say 164 exactly 164 numbers into your count!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 19 in a line?
quests.hint: Count places in order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... keep going until you reach position 19.
quests.explanation: Position 19 in a line is called the "Nineteenth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: The number 19 is a prime number -- only 1 and 19 divide it evenly!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: One Hundred Twenty-Nine
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "One Hundred Twenty-Nine" is how we say the number 129 in English, so 129 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: 129 is just 1 away from the round number 130!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 23, 28, 33, 38, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 5 each time. What comes after 38?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 38 comes 38 + 5 = 43!
quests.funFact: 43 is an odd number -- if you tried to split 43 things into two equal groups, one would always have an extra!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 148 or 183?
quests.question: 148 or 183
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 183 is greater than 148 -- when counting up, 183 comes later!
quests.funFact: 183 is an odd number -- if you tried to split 183 things into two equal groups, one would always have an extra!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 30 in a line?
quests.hint: Think of a race -- this word describes exactly which place a runner finished in.
quests.explanation: Position 30 in a line is called the "Thirtieth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: September, April, June, and November each have exactly 30 days!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 194, 106, or 199?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 194, 106, and 199, the number 199 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: The digit 9 sits in the ones place of 199, and the digit 9 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: One Hundred Fifty
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "One Hundred Fifty" is how we say the number 150 in English, so 150 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: A cricket match once lasted so long it was nicknamed after this number of overs!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 22, 24, 26, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 26 comes 26 + 2 = 28!
quests.funFact: The digit 8 sits in the ones place of 28, and the digit 2 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 99?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the ones digit in 99.
quests.explanation: In 99, the digit 9 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: Counting one by one from 1, you would say 99 exactly 99 numbers into your count!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 14 in a line?

quests.explanation: Position 14 in a line is called the "Fourteenth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: Valentine's Day always lands on the 14th day of February!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: One Hundred Eleven

quests.explanation: "One Hundred Eleven" is how we say the number 111 in English, so 111 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: 111 is just 1 away from the round number 110!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Count up to 197 in your head, saying each number word as you go.
quests.explanation: The numeral 197 is written in words as "One Hundred Ninety-Seven" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: 197 is just 3 away from the round number 200!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 161, 114, or 123?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the smaller one.
quests.explanation: Out of 161, 114, and 123, the number 114 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: The digit 4 sits in the ones place of 114, and the digit 1 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: Is 91 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Try to share 91 things between two friends equally -- does anyone get a leftover?
quests.explanation: 91 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 91 is Odd!
quests.funFact: 91 is just 1 away from the round number 90!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 196 or 158?
quests.question: 196 or 158
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 196 is greater than 158 -- when counting up, 196 comes later!
quests.funFact: 196 is an even number -- you could split 196 things into two equal, matching groups!

quests.instruction: Is 121 an odd number or an even number?

quests.funFact: 180 is an even number -- you could split 180 things into two equal, matching groups!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 173?

quests.explanation: In 173, the digit 3 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: 173 has a 1 in the hundreds place -- that's 1 full groups of one hundred!
